gotchas: https://www.jal.co.jp/jp/en/jmb/enroll/ is the page for residents of Japan. Its 'Open in New Window Online Membership Application' link opens a POPUP (call waitForPopup). The popup is the Japan-resident enrolment, so follow its 'American Region' (or Europe/Middle East/Africa, Asia/Oceania) link, which opens another popup.

Step 1 'Rules and Conditions, Country of Residence': tick the JMB Rules checkbox (click its wrapper, the input is hidden), choose the country in the native select (e.g. 'USA'), then the 'To e-mail authentication' link.

Step 2 'Send enrollment e-mail': two input[name*=mail i] (address and confirmation), then Send. JAL emails a URL. Customer information and the password come only after that link, so the link is the account owner's step: record the site as waiting and do not follow it.
The confirmation email field must match the first; fill the same email token into both.
